correctness.rationale: The proof characterizes forcing partial 3-assignments on paths and cycles by independent initially-uncoloured sets, then counts the induced ordinary 3-colourings after suppression. The formulas agree with exhaustive small-order enumeration and with the published P4 and C4 examples.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The full texts of arXiv:2609.17108v1 and arXiv:2406.15746v1 do not give the path/cycle family formulas, and exact plus synonymous searches found no prior equivalent result. The source paper is extremely recent, so unindexed parallel work remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result gives closed formulas and a linear-time arithmetic evaluation method for the full maximum-degree-two class in the only nontrivial colour-count case, and it corrects the lambda=3 K_{1,2} value printed in the current source paper.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
